description.value: Your Persistent Bloom aura (17th-level feature) expands to a 1-mile radius and reclaims ground at a hundred times its normal rate. Everything inside it that is trying to grow, grows. Everything inside it that is trying to rot, rots. You do not get to choose which things are which, and it will not stop because you asked it to.

cinderfall.incomplete: `TERRAIN-NULL` for the reclaim-rate/radius numbers. **Open question:** "Persistent Bloom" itself is referenced as a 17th-level class feature (`classes.seed-warden.json` progression line 84, level 17: "Persistent Bloom") but is not among these 69 files or anywhere else found in `site/data/cards/` — this card modifies a feature that doesn't appear to exist as a card yet.
